## Contributor Checklist

- [ ] The page has front matter with a clear title.
- [ ] The page is linked from the nearest relevant `index.md` if it should be discoverable.
- [ ] New folders have an `index.md` when readers should browse them.
- [ ] New breadcrumb defaults were added to `_config.yml` if needed.
- [ ] Reading paths were updated in `_data/reading_paths.yml` if needed.
- [ ] New symbols or conventions are consistent with the notation guide.
- [ ] Equations, tables, diagrams, and code blocks render acceptably.
- [ ] Larger site changes were checked with `bundle exec jekyll build`.
